notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 1643; AKU grapheme A0440 (AKU GR 43). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: A24 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 15. Facsimile type: Retro-Digitalisat (Publikation), by Georg Möller. Source scan (WEBP) converted to PNG at native resolution, flattened onto white, white margin added.
